name: Fresenius Medical Care AG
research_rationale: Q3 news shows flat revenue but margin pressure from US reimbursement and inflation; Barclays downgrade aligns; Investegate bodies remain wrong issuer, so the strong buy rests on Yahoo FCF, not verified DAX filings.

weekly_updates.summary:
Q3 2026 coverage: revenue broadly flat while operating income fell on US reimbursement (TDAPA) and inflation; 5008X rollout and profitable value-based care were cited as offsets.
Barclays cut Fresenius Medical Care to underweight (Nov) on reimbursement, weak volume growth and inflation; German commentary also flags lower broker targets and a surprise leadership change (Oct).
Indexed Investegate filing bodies are still Future Metals NL (AIM FME), not Fresenius Medical Care; the annual company-numbers extract remains empty.
